title: tecoma fulva subsp. arequipensis
intro: Tecoma fulva subsp. arequipensis, commonly known as Peruvian tea or yellow trumpet, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the trumpet vine family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Tecoma fulva subsp. arequipensis include vasodilation, diuretic, and antioxidant properties, which help to protect the body against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
